summary: A solid daily: everyone gets the big six, then Iran, Indonesia, Saudi Arabia and Canada make it a real test.
reasons: Casual player finds 8 quickly (China, US, India, Russia, Japan, Germany, Saudi Arabia, Canada) and then spends lives on UK, Brazil, Australia, France and South Korea.
Misses are near misses that teach something: South Korea is #11 by under 2 Mt, Brazil #13, the UK only #19.
Blitz works, but any country scores, so it plays like a country dump. Classic suits it better.
